offending_extra_words: during the term or for 12 months afterward
whether the employee responds to a general advertisement or applies unsolicited
shall have no obligation not to
reasons: The preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer) is achieved by deleting the covenant; instead the clause was rewritten into a double negative ("shall have no obligation not to solicit"), which is not the minimal change and reads awkwardly.

Retaining "during the term or for 12 months afterward" creates a dangling mechanic and a negative implication that a non-solicit/no-hire restriction on Customer exists after 12 months — the opposite of the locked preferred target.

The general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach language is carried over from the fallback bargain even though no covenant remains for it to qualify; it is surplus and mixes fallback terms into a preferred-level redline.

The clause does not meet the fallback either: it is not mutual, is not limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, and the 12-month period runs from the term rather than from the end of involvement.
Recommended fix: strike 12.4 in its entirety (or replace with "Intentionally omitted."), keeping the mutual-non-solicit fallback for negotiation in the margin comment only.
